notes: The portable C++ TCK checks that a negotiated divestiture with no acquirer leaves ownership with the offeror and does not request divestiture confirmation; when a joined federate later requests the attribute, the owner receives a standard confirmation request and ownership changes only after Confirm Divestiture. Direct pinned mappings are page-155-l164-45 and page-155-l167-46 -> IEEE 1516.1-2025 §7.3, and page-151-l27-8 -> §7.1.2.1. Tag and callback metadata are supplemental public-API observations. Both C++ primary and contract passed against the current-source installed package under evoked and immediate callback models (4/4); Java parity compiles against the official API-only JAR but has no provider-runtime evidence. The adapter supplies provider, endpoint, FOM, callback model, logical-time implementation, and object/attribute names. This is not a conformance claim.
